connector.name: MCP by artifacta.io
connector.registryDescription: Artifact store for AI agents. Hosted OAuth at mcp.artifacta.io/mcp; local stdio via npm/PyPI.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.artifacta.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.artifacta. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
